scope: Complete visible component families and all widget kinds; finite named states, not every command or parameter combination.

catalogue.scope: Every native catalogue identity, the commands that accept it and their parameters. Defaults and domains are quoted from the command guidance, projected from the emitter for weather-author, read back from the engine, observed from what the engine applies when a field is omitted, or observed from its refusals; each default and domain the guidance omits cites the native statement that applies it. Fields with none of these would be listed under gaps. Examples were run against the native library; this is not exhaustive parameter or visual qualification.
